questions.prompt: As of 2025, what percentage of one-year-old children worldwide have received 3 doses of the DTP (diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis) vaccine?
questions.insight: Despite pandemic-era setbacks and persistent gaps in poorer regions, the large majority of the world's infants are now fully DTP-vaccinated.

questions.prompt: As of 2024, what percentage of the world's land and inland water area is within officially documented protected or conserved areas?
questions.insight: Protected land has grown steadily but sits well below the global '30 by 30' target of protecting 30% of Earth's land by 2030.

questions.prompt: As of 2025, how many objects (mostly satellites) have been launched into outer space in total since Sputnik 1 in 1957?

source.name: Our World in Data (sourced from UNOOSA)

questions.insight: Roughly a fifth of all objects ever launched into space went up in just the last two years, driven by satellite mega-constellations.

questions.prompt: As of 2023, what percentage of the world's population is age 65 or older?
questions.insight: The share of people aged 65+ has roughly doubled since 1960 and keeps rising as birth rates fall and lifespans lengthen.

questions.prompt: What percentage of the world's total energy demand (not just electricity, but also transport, heating, and industry) was met by fossil fuels in 2023?
questions.insight: Clean electricity is growing fast, but fossil fuels still met about 80% of the world's total energy demand in 2023.
